Today's update includes news on the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
Cyclone Murasu made landfall on India's eastern coast yesterday, November 3rd. It crossed the Andhra coast with winds reaching up to 120 kilometers per hour, triggering heavy rainfall. The impact led to the cancellation of flights in Chennai and the closure of schools. Rain alerts were issued for Chennai and nine districts in Tamil Nadu. Light to moderate rain was expected in Chennai as the cyclone moved past the Andhra Pradesh coast. Latest updates today continue to track Cyclone Murasu, its affected areas, and warnings.
